Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
1 Can I play miniontap with no minions in play?
2 Excatly how works major boon? Can I play Telepathic counter after I play
it? Can another player play conditioning after I've played it?
3 Do I get the edge if I play sup Spying Mission?

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
Henke <d98...@stud.hh.se> wrote in message
news:9cali0$hcm$1...@taliesin.netcom.net.uk...
> 1 Can I play minion tap with no minions in play?

No.
Card text.
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_M.html#Minion_Tap_

> 2 Excatly how works major boon?

After a bleed is successful (ie not blocked), you play the card.
At this time, the acting minion may play action modifiers to increase the
amount of the bleed like Conditioning.
Also at this time, you could play reaction cards to reduce the amount of
pool you lost, like Ignis Fatuus (reduce a bleed against any Methuselah by
one), but you cannot play Telepathic Counter, as it is not a bleed against
you. (Card text on Telepathic Counter.)

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_T.html#Telepathic_Counter

Playing Major Boon does not change who is being bled, it only changes who
loses pool from the bleed.

>Can I play Telepathic counter after I play it?

No, but you may play other appropriate reaction cards.

>Can another player play conditioning after I've played it?

Yes.
(Card text of Major Boon.)
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_M.html#Major_Boon

> 3 Do I get the edge if I play sup Spying Mission?

No.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_S.html#Spying_Mission

From the Rules Team Rulings: (http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulings.html)
The bleed it is played on is considered unsuccessful. Previous Spying
Missions won't
be cashed in during that action. [RTR 19960530]

You cannot gain the edge for an unsuccessful bleed. It is a successful
action (ie, an
action that is not blocked), but it is not a successful bleed.

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
